description: Deploy a Docker image from a LOCAL `docker save` file (.tar, .tar.gz or .tgz) on this machine. The file is uploaded straight to SnapDeploy's storage with a presigned URL (never through the API), loaded, pushed to the private registry and started. The image must be built for linux/arm64 (docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64); an amd64 image fails at build time with a rebuild hint. Free accounts may upload up to 2 GB; any Always-On subscription raises the cap (the platform returns its store link on 402 — relay it, do not retry). Uses one deploy-limit unit like other deploys.

container.description: Container name (default: derived from the file name)

path.description: Absolute path of the docker-save file on this machine

port.description: Port the app listens on inside the container (default 8080)

size.description: small (512 MB, free) | medium (2 GB, STARTER Always-On) | large (4 GB, PRO Always-On)

name: deploy_image
